Hi Lisa — great to hear, and thanks for sending the Order Form. Looping in Karthik (legal), Marissa (contracts ops) and Naomi (onboarding) to start intake and scheduling.

Quick answers up front:
- Redwood can aim for an initial legal redline within 5 business days after we confirm party details and receive any counterparty exhibits.
- We prefer redlines in Word (we'll return an editable Order Form) and include our standard MSA plus Exhibit A (billing/usage) and Exhibit B (SLA).
- Karthik — please find the Order Form attached and advise on SOC2 evidence checklist.

I've attached a brief "party sheet" to speed intake (party_sheet_fintegration.xlsx). Can you confirm: legal entity legal name, billing address, primary signer name/email, and whether the data will be processed in us-west or eu regions?

Proposed next steps:
1) Fintegrate returns completed party sheet by 2027-04-27
2) Redwood legal issues initial redline by 2027-05-03
3) Contract review sync if there are material commercial changes (30-min call)

If that timeline works I will docket it in our contracting queue and create the redline template.

Best,

Thanks Vanessa / Lisa.

On Mon, Apr 25, 2027 at 11:03 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> I've attached a brief "party sheet" to speed intake (party_sheet_fintegration.xlsx). Can you confirm: legal entity legal name, billing address, primary signer name/email, and whether the data will be processed in us-west or eu regions?

We reviewed the Order Form and --- to set expectations for the first pass --- please note:
- Our standard MSA is attached as a redline_template.docx; we'll produce a tracked redline with commentary for any non-standard clauses (e.g., indemnity caps, data processing terms).
- For SOC2, Fintegrate may provide either a SOC2 Type II report or equivalent security questionnaire responses. If you have an auditor contact we can coordinate redaction-friendly transfer.
- Data residency: if Fintegrate requires EU-only processing, call that out on the party sheet; that will change routing and may lengthen the review by one business day while we validate regional infra.

Requests for Fintegrate:
1) Complete party_sheet_fintegration.xlsx and indicate the processing region and primary signer.
2) If any commercial edits are expected (discounts, seat counts, term length), flag them in an email so we can prioritize negotiable vs non-negotiable terms.

I'll circulate an editable Word redline (tracked changes) once we receive the completed party sheet. If helpful, Marissa and I can run a brief intake call Wednesday 2027-04-28 at 10:00 PT to walk through exhibits and any procurement constraints.

-Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
